---
title: "`r params$variable`"
subtitle: "`r params$subtitle`"
params:
  variable: "F9_01_REV_TOT_CY"
  report_type: "amount"
  subtitle: "Total revenue - current year · Amount report"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    css: report.css
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars-native_divs"
---

<!-- Web fonts load at view time; data-external keeps them out of the self-contained file -->
<link rel="stylesheet" data-external="1" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Zilla+Slab:wght@500;600;700&family=Source+Sans+3:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Source+Code+Pro:wght@400;600&display=swap">

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "asis",
                      fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 3.6, dpi = 110, dev = "png")
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

v     <- params$variable
rtype <- params$report_type
xp    <- cc[variable_name == v]
xp[, form := xpath_form(xpath)]

st <- ev$stats[xpath %in% xp$xpath]
den <- ev$filings[, .(den = sum(n_filings)), by = .(tax_year, return_type)]

xs <- st[, .(n_filings = sum(n_filings), first_year = min(tax_year), last_year = max(tax_year),
             n_versions = uniqueN(schema_version), n_repeat = sum(n_filings_repeat),
             max_per_filing = max(max_per_filing)), by = xpath]
xp <- merge(xp, xs, by = "xpath", all.x = TRUE)
xp[is.na(n_filings), n_filings := 0]
sm <- series_map(xp$xpath, xp$n_filings, fifelse(is.na(xp$first_year), 9999L, as.integer(xp$first_year)))
xp <- merge(xp, sm, by = "xpath")
st <- merge(st, sm, by = "xpath")
pal <- setNames(unique(sm[, .(series, color)])$color, unique(sm[, .(series, color)])$series)
scale_series <- function(aes = c("colour", "fill")) {
  scale_discrete_manual(aes, values = pal, drop = TRUE, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
}

flags <- if (nrow(ev$flags)) ev$flags[variable_name == v | xpath %in% xp$xpath] else data.table()
fmt_n <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
years_observed <- if (nrow(st)) paste0(min(st$tax_year), "&ndash;", max(st$tax_year)) else "never observed"
type_label <- c(amount = "Amount (dollars)", number = "Number (count, ratio or percent)",
                checkbox = "Checkbox", date = "Date or year", text = "Free text",
                code = "Code (categorical)", identifier = "Identifier")[[rtype]]
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
fam <- cc[location_code_family == xp$location_code_family[1], unique(variable_name)]
fam <- setdiff(fam, v)
kv <- c(
  "Description"   = htmltools::htmlEscape(unique(na.omit(xp$description))[1]),
  "Table"         = sprintf("<code>%s</code> (%s)", xp$rdb_table[1], tolower(xp$rdb_relationship[1])),
  "Location code" = sprintf("<code>%s</code>", paste(unique(xp$location_code), collapse = "</code>, <code>")),
  "Family"        = sprintf("<code>%s</code>%s", xp$location_code_family[1],
                            if (length(fam)) paste0(" &middot; siblings: ", paste(head(fam, 6), collapse = ", ")) else ""),
  "Data type"     = sprintf("%s (xsd: %s)", xp$data_type_simple[1],
                            paste(unique(na.omit(xp$data_type_xsd)), collapse = ", ")),
  "Scope"         = paste(unique(xp$variable_scope), collapse = ", "),
  "Status"        = "unreviewed"
)
cat('<div class="concepts"><dl class="kv">',
    paste0("<dt>", names(kv), "</dt><dd>", kv, "</dd>", collapse = "\n"), "</dl></div>")

n_fil <- sum(xp$n_filings)
cat('<div class="tiles">',
    sprintf('<div class="tile"><div class="v">%s</div><div class="k">xpaths mapped (%d observed)</div></div>',
            nrow(xp), sum(xp$n_filings > 0)),
    sprintf('<div class="tile"><div class="v">%s</div><div class="k">filings with a value</div></div>', fmt_n(n_fil)),
    sprintf('<div class="tile"><div class="v">%s</div><div class="k">tax years observed</div></div>', years_observed),
    sprintf('<div class="tile"><div class="v">%d</div><div class="k">open flags (%d errors)</div></div>',
            nrow(flags), sum(flags$severity == "error")),
    '</div>')
```

## Flags

```{r flags}
if (!nrow(flags)) {
  cat("<p>No open flags.</p>")
} else {
  sev_lab <- c(error = "&#9888; error", warn = "&#9650; warn", info = "&#9432; info")
  rows <- sprintf('<tr><td><span class="sev sev-%s">%s</span></td><td><code>%s</code></td><td class="wrap">%s</td><td class="wrap">%s</td></tr>',
                  flags$severity, sev_lab[flags$severity], flags$flag_code,
                  htmltools::htmlEscape(ifelse(is.na(flags$xpath), "(variable)", short_xpath(flags$xpath))),
                  htmltools::htmlEscape(one_line(flags$detail)))
  cat('<div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Severity</th><th>Flag</th><th>Xpath</th><th>Detail</th></tr></thead><tbody>',
      rows, "</tbody></table></div>", sep = "\n")
}
```

## Xpaths

```{r xpaths}
tab <- xp[order(series), .(Xpath = short_xpath(xpath), Form = form,
                           `Chart label` = fifelse(as.character(series) == short_xpath(xpath), "same", as.character(series)),
                           `First year` = first_year, `Last year` = last_year, Versions = n_versions,
                           Filings = n_filings,
                           `Repeats in` = fifelse(n_filings > 0, sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_repeat / pmax(n_filings, 1)), ""))]
if (all(tab$`Chart label` == "same")) tab[, `Chart label` := NULL]
html_table(tab, caption = "All mapped xpaths (under /Return/ReturnData or /Return/ReturnHeader), oldest first. Charts label each series by its xpath.")
```

## Coverage

```{r coverage, fig.height = 3.4}
if (nrow(st)) {
  by_year <- st[, .(n = sum(n_filings)), by = .(tax_year, series)]
  p <- ggplot(by_year, aes(tax_year, n, fill = series)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = report_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_series("fill") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009, 2024, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
    labs(title = "Filings with a value, by tax year and xpath",
         subtitle = "The switch between xpaths shows where the schema renamed the element",
         x = NULL, y = "Filings") +
    theme_report()
  print(p)
  html_table(dcast(by_year, tax_year ~ series, value.var = "n", fill = 0)[, `Tax year` := tax_year][, tax_year := NULL][] |>
               setcolorder("Tax year"), caption = "Table view: filings by tax year and series", collapse = TRUE)
} else cat("<p>This variable was never observed in the filing evidence.</p>")
```

```{r fillrate, fig.height = 3.2}
if (nrow(st)) {
  fr <- st[return_type %in% c("990", "990EZ", "990PF"), .(n = sum(n_filings)), by = .(tax_year, return_type)]
  fr <- merge(fr, den, by = c("tax_year", "return_type"))
  fr[, rate := n / den]
  fr[, rt := factor(return_type, levels = c("990", "990EZ", "990PF"), labels = c("Form 990", "Form 990-EZ", "Form 990-PF"))]
  p <- ggplot(fr, aes(tax_year, rate, colour = rt)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = report_palette[1:3], drop = TRUE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2009, 2024, 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(title = "Share of filings with a value (fill rate), by return type", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_report()
  print(p)
  html_table(fr[order(tax_year, rt), .(`Tax year` = tax_year, `Return type` = rt, Filings = n,
                                        `All filings` = den, `Fill rate` = sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * rate))],
             caption = "Table view: fill rate", collapse = TRUE)
}
```

```{r repeats}
rep_x <- xp[n_repeat > 0]
if (nrow(rep_x) || identical(xp$rdb_relationship[1], "MANY")) {
  cat("## Repeating groups\n\n")
  g <- ev$groups[xpath %in% xp$xpath, .(filings = sum(n_filings)), by = .(xpath, repeat_root)]
  g <- g[, .(Xpath = short_xpath(xpath), `Repeating element` = fifelse(repeat_root == "", "(none)", short_xpath(repeat_root)),
             `Filings (summed over years)` = filings)]
  cat(sprintf("<p>Table cardinality in the concordance: <b>%s</b>. %d of %d observed xpaths repeat within a filing.</p>",
              tolower(xp$rdb_relationship[1]), nrow(rep_x), sum(xp$n_filings > 0)))
  html_table(g, caption = "Repeating element each xpath was observed in (from the raw indexed xpath)")
}
```

## Examples

```{r examples}
ex <- ev$examples[xpath %in% xp$xpath]
if (nrow(ex)) {
  ex <- ex[order(-tax_year)][, .SD[1], by = .(xpath, tax_year)]
  ex <- ex[order(-tax_year)][seq_len(min(.N, 12))]
  rows <- sprintf("<tr><td class='num'>%s</td><td>%s</td><td class='wrap'>%s</td><td class='wrap'>%s</td><td class='wrap'>%s</td><td><a href='%s'>XML</a></td></tr>",
                  ex$tax_year, ex$return_type, htmltools::htmlEscape(short_xpath(ex$xpath)),
                  htmltools::htmlEscape(one_line(ex$org_name)), htmltools::htmlEscape(one_line(ex$value)), xml_url(ex$objectid))
  cat('<div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tbl"><thead><tr><th>Tax year</th><th>Return</th><th>Xpath</th><th>Organization</th><th>Value</th><th>Source</th></tr></thead><tbody>',
      rows, "</tbody></table></div>", sep = "\n")
} else cat("<p class='muted'>No examples.</p>")
```

## Reviewer checklist

```{r checklist}
common <- c(
  "The definition matches the form line and instructions for every xpath's schema years.",
  "Every xpath pooled here measures the same thing on the 990 and 990-EZ (close enough for analysis).",
  "The coverage chart has no unexplained gaps or jumps between tax years.",
  "Each open flag is fixed, or accepted with a note in validation_log.csv."
)
cat('<ul class="checklist">', paste0("<li>", c(common, checklist), "</li>"), "</ul>", sep = "\n")
cat(sprintf("<p class='muted'>Record the review as a row in <code>inst/extdata/src/validation_log.csv</code> (variable_name, reviewer, date, status, note). Evidence built %s from the ef2 DuckDB builds (tax years %s).</p>",
            htmltools::htmlEscape(ev$manifest$built %||% "(unknown)"),
            if (nrow(ev$filings)) paste(unique(range(ev$filings$tax_year)), collapse = "&ndash;") else "unknown"))
```
